name: municipal
description: Town of Sampleton (fictional) budget, grant and spending ledger: FY2026 and FY2027 through 2026-10-31. Synthetic demo data; all money in integer cents.
domain: municipal budget, grant and spending data
notes: All money columns end in _cents and hold INTEGER CENTS.
The fiscal year runs July 1 to June 30: fiscal_year 2026 covers 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30. FY2027 data runs through 2026-10-31.
expenditures.status is 'paid', 'pending' (approved but unpaid, paid_date NULL) or 'void'. 'Spent' means status = 'paid'. Always exclude 'void' rows.
expenditures.grant_id is NULL for spending not charged to a grant.
Grant IDs look like 'G-402'; 'grant 402' or '#402' means grant_id = 'G-402'.
A grant's remaining balance is award_cents minus its paid expenditures.
grant_drawdowns record cash requested from the grantor; status is 'received' or 'pending' (received_date NULL).
budget_lines.adopted_cents is the original budget and amended_cents the current one; compare spending against amended_cents.

grant-status.description: Per grant: award, paid spending, pending spending, cash drawn down, remaining balance and percent of award spent. Use for 'how much of grant X is spent', remaining balances, and drawdown-versus-spending questions.

grant_id.description: A grant ID such as G-402. Omit for every grant.

status.description: Limit to active or closed grants.

grant-status.sql: SELECT g.grant_id, g.grant_name, g.grantor, g.status, g.award_cents, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) AS paid_cents, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id AND e.status = 'pending'), 0) AS pending_cents, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.amount_cents) FROM grant_drawdowns d WHERE d.grant_id = g.grant_id AND d.status = 'received'), 0) AS drawn_cents, g.award_cents - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) AS remaining_cents, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.amount_cents) FROM grant_drawdowns d WHERE d.grant_id = g.grant_id AND d.status = 'received'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) AS drawn_minus_paid_cents, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) / g.award_cents, 1) AS pct_award_spent FROM grants g WHERE (:grant_id IS NULL OR g.grant_id = :grant_id) AND (:status IS NULL OR g.status = :status) ORDER BY g.grant_id

checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount_cents), 0) AS total FROM expenditures e WHERE e.status = 'paid' AND e.grant_id IN (SELECT g.grant_id FROM grants g WHERE (:grant_id IS NULL OR g.grant_id = :grant_id) AND (:status IS NULL OR g.status = :status))

checks.message: Paid spending exceeds the grant award.
More grant cash has been drawn down than has been spent; the excess is grantor money held in advance.

spending-by-vendor.description: Paid spending and invoice count per vendor, optionally for one grant, fiscal year or department. Use for 'who was paid', 'spending by vendor' and vendor concentration questions.

grant_id.description: A grant ID such as G-402.

dept_id.description: Department ID: PW, PR, LIB, PD, SR or FIN.

spending-by-vendor.sql: SELECT v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, COUNT(e.expenditure_id) AS invoice_count, SUM(e.amount_cents) AS paid_cents FROM expenditures e JOIN vendors v ON v.vendor_id = e.vendor_id JOIN budget_lines b ON b.line_id = e.line_id WHERE e.status = 'paid' AND (:grant_id IS NULL OR e.grant_id = :grant_id) AND (:fiscal_year IS NULL OR e.fiscal_year = :fiscal_year) AND (:dept_id IS NULL OR b.dept_id = :dept_id) GROUP BY v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name ORDER BY SUM(e.amount_cents) DESC, v.vendor_id

checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount_cents), 0) AS total FROM expenditures e WHERE e.status = 'paid' AND (:grant_id IS NULL OR e.grant_id = :grant_id) AND (:fiscal_year IS NULL OR e.fiscal_year = :fiscal_year) AND (:dept_id IS NULL OR e.line_id IN (SELECT b.line_id FROM budget_lines b WHERE b.dept_id = :dept_id))

budget-variance.description: Per budget line: adopted and amended budget, paid and pending spending, remaining budget and percent used. Use for overspending, budget-versus-actual and remaining-budget questions.

dept_id.description: Department ID: PW, PR, LIB, PD, SR or FIN.

budget-variance.sql: SELECT b.line_id, b.fiscal_year, d.dept_name, b.line_description, b.adopted_cents, b.amended_cents, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.line_id = b.line_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) AS paid_cents, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.line_id = b.line_id AND e.status = 'pending'), 0) AS pending_cents, b.amended_cents - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.line_id = b.line_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) AS remaining_cents, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount_cents) FROM expenditures e WHERE e.line_id = b.line_id AND e.status = 'paid'), 0) / b.amended_cents, 1) AS pct_used FROM budget_lines b JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = b.dept_id WHERE (:fiscal_year IS NULL OR b.fiscal_year = :fiscal_year) AND (:dept_id IS NULL OR b.dept_id = :dept_id) ORDER BY b.fiscal_year, b.line_id

checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount_cents), 0) AS total FROM expenditures e WHERE e.status = 'paid' AND e.line_id IN (SELECT b.line_id FROM budget_lines b WHERE (:fiscal_year IS NULL OR b.fiscal_year = :fiscal_year) AND (:dept_id IS NULL OR b.dept_id = :dept_id))

checks.message: This budget line has spent more than its amended budget.
